title: Coverage eligibility
summary: Eligible hospitalization claims require proof of treatment, billing documentation, discharge summary, and policy validity at the time of treatment.

title: Document checklist
summary: Missing or mismatched documents can delay payment. Final discharge certificate, original invoice, and hospital signed forms are required before settlement.

title: Deductible and co-pay
summary: The approved claim amount is reduced by the applicable deductible and co-pay as per the selected plan. The claim advisor should clearly explain these calculations.

title: Motor repair and garage flow
summary: Motor claims need photos, a repair estimate, and invoice matching to confirm the repair value before the settlement is approved.
